blocks.etymology: From Ottoman Turkish ولایت (vilayet, “province”), from Arabic وِلَايَة (wilāya, “province, administration”). Doublet of wilaya, wilayat, and Blighty.

wiktionary.gloss: A province, particularly (historical) the first-level administrative divisions of the Ottoman Empire.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English ward, warde, from Old English weard (“watching, ward, protection, guardianship; advance post; waiting for, lurking, ambuscade”), from Proto-West Germanic *wardu, from Proto-Germanic *wardō (“protection, attention, keeping”), an extension of the stem *wara- (“attentive”) (English wary, beware), from Proto-Indo-European *wer- (“to cover”). Cognate with German Warte (“watchtower”), warten (“wait for”); English guard is a parallel form which came via Old French.

senses.definition: a large room in a hospital with beds for patients

examples.en: She was moved to the maternity ward after giving birth.
examples.vi: Cô ấy được chuyển đến khoa sản sau khi sinh con.

senses.vi: phòng bệnh; khu bệnh

senses.definition: a specific area of a town or city used for local government and voting

examples.en: He represents our ward on the local council.
examples.vi: Ông ấy đại diện cho phường của chúng tôi tại hội đồng địa phương.

senses.vi: phường; khu vực bầu cử

senses.definition: a child or young person who is legally protected by a guardian or court

examples.en: The boy became a ward of court when his parents died.
examples.vi: Cậu bé trở thành người được tòa án bảo trợ khi cha mẹ qua đời.

senses.vi: người được bảo trợ; người được giám hộ

thesaurus.definition: a person who is under the protection or in the custody of another
a district into which a city or town is divided for the purpose of administration and elections
block forming a division of a hospital (or a suite of rooms) shared by patients who need a similar kind of care
a division of a prison (usually consisting of several cells)

vi_block: Sự trông nom, sự bảo trợ; sự giam giữ.
Phòng, khu (nhà thương); phòng giam (nhà tù).

wiktionary.gloss: The action of a watchman; monitoring, surveillance (usually in phrases keep ward etc.)
Guardianship, especially of a child or prisoner.
An enchantment or spell placed over a designated area or social unit, that prevents any tresspasser from entering; approaching; or even being able to locate said protected premises or demographic.
A guarding or defensive motion or position.
Land tenure through military service.
An area of a castle, corresponding to a circuit of the walls.
A section or subdivision of a prison.

examples: On our last visit to Tokyo, we went to Chiyoda ward and visited the Emperor’s palace.
wiktionary.gloss: An administrative division of a borough, city or council.
A division of a forest.
A subdivision of the LDS Church, smaller than and part of a stake, but larger than a branch.
A part of a hospital, with beds, where patients reside.

examples: After the trial, little Robert was declared a ward of the state.
wiktionary.gloss: A minor looked after by a guardian.
An object used for guarding.

examples: A man muſt thorowly ſound himſelfe, and dive into his heart, and there ſee by what wards or ſprings the motions ſtirre.
wiktionary.gloss: The ridges on the inside of a lock, or the incisions on a key.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English warden, from Old English weardian (“to watch, guard, keep, protect, preserve; hold, possess, occupy, inhabit; rule, govern”), from Proto-West Germanic *wardēn, from Proto-Germanic *wardōną, *wardāną (“to guard”), from Proto-Indo-European *wer- (“to heed, defend”). Doublet of guard.

senses.definition: to stop something harmful or unpleasant from affecting or reaching you

examples.en: She wore a heavy jacket to ward off the freezing wind.
examples.vi: Cô ấy mặc một chiếc áo khoác dày để ngăn những cơn gió lạnh buốt.

examples.en: He took vitamin C every morning to ward off illness.
examples.vi: Anh ấy uống vitamin C mỗi sáng để phòng ngừa bệnh tật.

senses.vi: ngăn chặn; xua đuổi; phòng ngừa

thesaurus.definition: watch over or shield from danger or harm; protect

wiktionary.gloss: To keep in safety, to watch over, to guard.
To defend, to protect.
To fend off, to repel, to turn aside, as anything mischievous that approaches. (usually followed by off)
wiktionary.vi: tránh; đỡ; gạt; phòng; ngăn ngừa

wiktionary.gloss: To be vigilant; to keep guard.
To act on the defensive with a weapon.

idioms.gloss: To keep constant watch over
